item.title: Plant Obstructing the View at Zebra Crossing – Accident-Prone Area, 9th August
item.description:
Overgrown plants and vegetation are obstructing drivers’ visibility at the zebra crossing, creating a significant road-safety concern. This crossing is frequently used by pedestrians, including young children and families, as well as cyclists. The vegetation makes it difficult for approaching drivers to clearly see pedestrians waiting to cross and for pedestrians to see approaching vehicles. Minor accidents and near-misses have already been observed in this area, increasing concerns that a more serious accident could occur if the obstruction is not addressed. Please arrange for the vegetation to be inspected and trimmed back to restore clear visibility for both drivers and pedestrians. Given the frequent use of this crossing by young children and cyclists, we would appreciate this being treated as a priority safety issue.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Brunel Road, Bermondsey, Greater London

item.title: [PARKING RESTRICTIONS] Sign Removed or Damaged, 9th August
item.description:
Am writing to report that the parking restriction sign stating that parking is restricted between 8:30am and 6:30pm at Marychurch Estate SE16 4HY appears to have been removed or damaged/vandalised. As a result, many vehicles are now parking in the estate without the necessary permits. This is causing significant problems for residents who have valid parking permits, as there are no longer enough spaces available for them. This is particularly difficult for residents who work shifts and return home from night shifts, only to find that they cannot park in the space allocated for permit holders. Could you please investigate this issue and arrange for the damaged/missing parking restriction sign to be repaired or replaced as soon as possible? We would also appreciate it if the council could review the parking situation at the estate and take appropriate action to ensure that the parking restrictions are properly enforced. Thank you for your assistance.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Rupack Street, Bermondsey, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Dog owners regularly let their dogs foul on the grass outside residents’ windows and fail to clean up afterwards., 9th August
item.description:
This has been an ongoing problem for quite some time. The same dog owners regularly allow their dog to foul on the grass directly outside our homes, underneath residents’ windows, and often fail to clean it up afterwards. This has become a recurring and unpleasant issue for residents, as dog waste is repeatedly left on the shared grass. It is unhygienic, inconsiderate and unacceptable in a residential area. Please investigate this ongoing problem and take appropriate action.
